title: NGO Turnover Analysis Tool
subtitle: Transforming temporal distributions into actionable governance insights
abstract: A Python/Streamlit application for nonprofit HR managers who have never written code. Upload Excel, receive tenure-window turnover analysis, Sankey flow diagrams, and cost estimates (C ≈ 0.8S per SHRM methodology). Categorizes each termination into six temporal windows and surfaces cohort retention patterns that scalar turnover rates obscure.
methodology: Cohort retention analysis, Sankey flow visualization, predictive risk flagging
